scripts.check:convex-generated: DOPPLER_CONFIG=stg tsx scripts/with-env.ts pnpm --filter backend check:generated
scripts.dead-code: sh -c 'status=0; pnpm exec knip --production --workspace . --no-config-hints || status=$?; pnpm --dir backend exec knip --production --no-config-hints || status=$?; pnpm --dir frontend exec knip --production --no-config-hints || status=$?; exit $status'
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:root && pnpm lint:convex && pnpm lint:angular && pnpm check:authz-boundaries && pnpm exec ifttt-lint --scan . && (if [ -n "$BASE_SHA" ]; then MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD "$BASE_SHA" 2>/dev/null || echo "HEAD~1"); git diff "$MERGE_BASE" HEAD | pnpm exec ifttt-lint -; else git diff HEAD | pnpm exec ifttt-lint -; fi)
scripts.lint:angular: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts pnpm --filter frontend exec ng lint frontend --max-warnings=-1
scripts.screenshot:frontend: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts pnpm --filter frontend screenshot
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:frontend && pnpm typecheck:convex && pnpm typecheck:scripts && pnpm typecheck:shared && pnpm typecheck:ops
scripts.typecheck:frontend: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts pnpm --filter frontend exec ng build --configuration=development --progress=false && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.spec.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p frontend/scripts/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p frontend/functions/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:scripts: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p backend/scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:convex:sandbox:preflight: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts env STRIPE_SANDBOX_CONTRACT_TESTS=true pnpm --filter backend test:sandbox:preflight
scripts.test:convex:sandbox: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts env STRIPE_SANDBOX_CONTRACT_TESTS=true pnpm --filter backend test:sandbox
scripts.test:frontend: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.test:frontend:debug: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts env VITEST_VERBOSE=1 pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.test:frontend:report: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts env VITEST_VERBOSE=1 VITEST_JSON=1 pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.test:frontend:watch: npx tsx scripts/with-env.ts pnpm --filter frontend test:watch
